comparisons.peer_summary: EBU operating income decreased in 2024 compared to 2023, primarily due to declines in average selling prices, partially offset by higher bit shipments and cost reductions.
comparisons.comparison: Both AMD and Micron discuss segment operating income changes for the fiscal year 2024 driven by lower revenue or pricing, though the magnitude and offsetting factors differ. AMD reports an Embedded operating income decline from $2.6 billion to $1.4 billion, primarily driven by lower revenue. Similarly, Micron reports EBU operating income decreased in 2024 compared to 2023, primarily due to declines in average selling prices, although this was partially offset by higher bit shipments and cost reductions.
